responsibility: Implements the full-width AVX-512 FP16 intrinsic interface, introducing GCC’s _Float16-based 512-bit half-precision vector types and the large API for FP16 arithmetic, conversions, reductions, permutations, and complex-half helpers. This is the primary 512-bit header for AVX512FP16 functionality, including vector constructors and FP16/complex aliases, while narrower 128/256-bit support lives in the separate VL companion header.
